sql: select (select count(*) from public.notifications where type = 'lead_lost') notif_lead_lost_total, (select json_agg(x) from (select c.name, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where l.responsavel_id is not null) com_responsavel from public.lead_history h join public.campaign_leads l on l.id = h.lead_id join public.companies c on c.id = h.company_id where h.action = 'Lead movido para perdido automaticamente' and h.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' group by c.name) x) perdidos_30d
